pages.title: Two colored lines · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine in the morning at a trailhead near Seattle. Tall green trees surround a small wooden hut. Tina arrives with a backpack and hiking boots. She looks at a map with two colored lines. A ranger named Ben steps out of the hut. He greets her with a smile.
“Hi! Which trail do you recommend?” says Tina. “We have two. The lake trail and the hill trail.” says Ranger Ben. “Which one is easier?” says Tina.

pages.title: Two colored lines · 3/3
paragraphs: “Good choice. Bring water and a hat. It’s hot.” says Ranger Ben. “Thanks! How long does it take?” says Tina. Tina fills her bottle and puts on a hat. She walks the lake trail slowly. She stops to take photos of the water. A small deer drinks near the shore. After one hour, she returns tired but calm. The easiest path can hold the best moments.
